correctness.rationale: For independent uniform q-th-root phases, centered purity P−μ=(4/N²)∑_{rectangles} Re(z_rectangle), where N=UV. Each rectangle has mean zero, pairwise distinct rectangles are uncorrelated. In cubic expansion, only three copies of the same plaquette (q=3: moment 1/4) or triangle of 3 different rectangles supported on 2×3/3×2 grids survive. Ordered triples contribute 6T for q=2 or 6T/4 otherwise, with lone q=3 contribution R/4. Therefore E[(P−μ)^3]=64/N^6 times [6T,(6T+R)/4,3T/2] for q=2,3,>=4/continuous, respectively, with established variance and skewness. Independent complete finite phase-state expectation computations for U,V=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3), alphabets 2,3,4: eight cases, 25,437 enumerated states, all exact target moments to numerical comparison tolerance; full proof is exponent-divisibility argument, not the tests.
